title: "[feat] "

**The problem**

What does your program need to know about, or do with, a coding-agent CLI that agentio cannot answer today?

**Vendor and version**

Which agent (Claude Code, Codex, another CLI) and which version you saw it in.

**Real shape**

agentio only models shapes seen on a real install. If you can, paste a sample of the file or response with every value replaced, or link the vendor source or changelog entry.

**Proposed API**

What you would like to call. Be concrete.

**Additional context**

Anything else.
